    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "// src/components/Login.tsx\n\n// test comment\n\nimport React, { useState } from 'react';\nimport { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { signInWithEmailAndPassword } from 'firebase/auth';\nimport { auth } from '../firebase';\nimport { Form, FormInput, FormFieldGroup } from './ui/Form';\nimport { Button } from './ui/Button';\nimport { Eye, EyeOff, Mail, Lock, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';\nimport { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';\nimport { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';\n\nconst Login: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const { loginWithGoogle, loginWithApple } = useAuth();\n  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');\n  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');\n  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState('');\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n\n  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) =\u003e {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    if (loading) return; // Prevent double submission\n    setLoading(true);\n    setError('');\n\n    const trimmedEmail = email.trim();\n    const trimmedPassword = password.trim();\n\n    if (!trimmedEmail || !trimmedPassword) {\n      setError(t('auth.errors.emailPasswordRequired'));\n      setLoading(false);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      await signInWithEmailAndPassword(auth, trimmedEmail, trimmedPassword);\n      navigate('/');\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error('Login error:', error);\n      setError(\n        error.code === 'auth/user-not-found' || error.code === 'auth/wrong-password'\n          ? t('auth.errors.invalidCredentials')\n          : error.code === 'auth/too-many-requests'\n          ? t('auth.errors.tooManyRequests')\n          : t('auth.errors.loginError')\n      );\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };",

            "text": "import { signInWithEmailAndPassword } from 'firebase/auth';"

        "originalContents": "// src/components/Login.tsx\n\n// test comment\n\nimport React, { useState } from 'react';\nimport { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { signInWithEmailAndPassword } from 'firebase/auth';\nimport { auth } from '../firebase';\nimport { Form, FormInput, FormFieldGroup } from './ui/Form';\nimport { Button } from './ui/Button';\nimport { Eye, EyeOff, Mail, Lock, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';\nimport { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';\nimport { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';\n\nconst Login: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const { loginWithGoogle, loginWithApple } = useAuth();\n  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');\n  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');\n  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState('');\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n\n  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) =\u003e {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    if (loading) return; // Prevent double submission\n    setLoading(true);\n    setError('');\n\n    const trimmedEmail = email.trim();\n    const trimmedPassword = password.trim();\n\n    if (!trimmedEmail || !trimmedPassword) {\n      setError(t('auth.errors.emailPasswordRequired'));\n      setLoading(false);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      await signInWithEmailAndPassword(auth, trimmedEmail, trimmedPassword);\n      navigate('/');\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error('Login error:', error);\n      setError(\n        error.code === 'auth/user-not-found' || error.code === 'auth/wrong-password'\n          ? t('auth.errors.invalidCredentials')\n          : error.code === 'auth/too-many-requests'\n          ? t('auth.errors.tooManyRequests')\n          : t('auth.errors.loginError')\n      );\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };",

'User logged in' : 'No user');\n          setCurrentUser(user);\n          setLoading(false);\n          \n          // Mock user profile for analytics\n          if (user) {\n            setUserProfile({\n              id: user.uid,\n              email: user.email,\n              displayName: user.displayName || 'User',\n              photoURL: user.photoURL,\n              role: 'crew_member', // Mock role\n              department: 'production', // Mock department\n              experience: 'intermediate', // Mock experience level\n            });\n          } else {\n            setUserProfile(null);\n          }\n        } catch (error) {\n          console.error('[AuthProvider] Error in auth state change handler:', error);\n          setLoading(false);\n        }\n      });\n\n      return unsubscribe;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('[AuthProvider] Error setting up auth state listener:', error);\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  }, []);\n\n  const value = {\n    currentUser,\n    loading,\n    userProfile,\n    login,\n    signup,\n    loginWithGoogle,\n    loginWithApple,\n    logout,\n    deleteAccount\n  };\n\n  return (\n    \u003cAuthContext.Provider value={value}\u003e\n      {children}\n    \u003c/AuthContext.Provider\u003e\n  );\n};",

        "contents": "import React, { useState } from 'react';\nimport { useNavigate, Link } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';\nimport { Eye, EyeOff, Mail, Lock, User, ArrowRight } from 'lucide-react';\n\nconst RegisterPage: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const [firstName, setFirstName] = useState('');\n  const [lastName, setLastName] = useState('');\n  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');\n  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');\n  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState('');\n  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);\n  const [showConfirmPassword, setShowConfirmPassword] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState('');\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);\n  const { signup } = useAuth();\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n\n  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) =\u003e {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    \n    if (!firstName.trim() || !lastName.trim()) {\n      return setError('First name and last name are required');\n    }\n\n    if (password !== confirmPassword) {\n      return setError('Passwords do not match');\n    }\n\n    if (password.length \u003c 6) {\n      return setError('Password must be at least 6 characters');\n    }\n\n    try {\n      setError('');\n      setLoading(true);\n      await signup(email, password, firstName.trim(), lastName.trim());\n      navigate('/edit-profile');\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError('Failed to create an account');\n      console.error(err);\n    }\n    setLoading(false);\n  };",

        "contents": "// src/components/Register.tsx\n\nimport React, { useState } from 'react';\nimport { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';\nimport { Form, FormInput, FormFieldGroup } from './ui/Form';\nimport { Button } from './ui/Button';\nimport { Eye, EyeOff, Mail, Lock, User, AlertCircle, CheckCircle } from 'lucide-react';\nimport { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';\n\nconst Register: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { signup, loginWithGoogle, loginWithApple } = useAuth();\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({\n    firstName: '',\n    lastName: '',\n    email: '',\n    password: '',\n    confirmPassword: ''\n  });\n  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);\n  const [showConfirmPassword, setShowConfirmPassword] = useState(false);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState('');\n  const [success, setSuccess] = useState('');\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n\n  const handleInputChange = (field: string, value: string) =\u003e {\n    setFormData(prev =\u003e ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));\n    setError(''); // Clear error when user starts typing\n  };\n\n  const validateForm = () =\u003e {\n    if (!formData.firstName.trim() || !formData.lastName.trim()) {\n      setError(t('auth.errors.nameRequired'));\n      return false;\n    }\n    if (!formData.email.trim()) {\n      setError(t('auth.errors.emailRequired'));\n      return false;\n    }\n    if (formData.password.length \u003c 6) {\n      setError(t('auth.errors.passwordLength'));\n      return false;\n    }\n    if (formData.password !== formData.confirmPassword) {\n      setError(t('auth.errors.passwordMatch'));\n      return false;\n    }\n    return true;\n  };",

        "contents": "const RegisterForm: React.FC =\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  // --- The new, combined handleSubmit logic ---\n  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) =\u003e {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    if (!form.email || !form.password || !form.name) {\n      setError(\"Please fill out your email, password, and name.\");\n      return;\n    }\n    setLoading(true);\n    setError(null);\n\n    try {\n      // 1. Create user in Firebase Auth using AuthContext (creates basic crewProfiles document)\n      await signup(form.email, form.password, form.name.split(' ')[0], form.name.split(' ').slice(1).join(' '));\n      \n      // 2. Upload profile image if one was selected\n      let uploadedImageUrl = '';\n      if (imageFile) {\n        const storageRef = ref(storage, &#96;profileImages/${form.email}&#96;);\n        await uploadBytes(storageRef, imageFile);\n        uploadedImageUrl = await getDownloadURL(storageRef);\n      }\n\n      // Always ensure name and image are set\n      const safeName = form.name \u0026\u0026 form.name.trim() !== '' ? form.name : 'Unknown Crew';\n      const safeProfileImageUrl = uploadedImageUrl \u0026\u0026 uploadedImageUrl.trim() !== '' ? uploadedImageUrl : '/default-avatar.svg';\n\n      // 3. Update the crewProfiles document with additional details\n      // Note: We need to get the user ID from the current user context\n      // For now, we'll create a more detailed profile after signup\n      const detailedProfile = {\n        name: safeName,\n        bio: form.bio,\n        profileImageUrl: safeProfileImageUrl,\n        jobTitles: form.jobTitles.filter(j =\u003e j.department \u0026\u0026 j.title), // Only save completed entries\n        residences: form.residences.filter(r =\u003e r.country \u0026\u0026 r.city),\n        userType: form.userType,\n        availability: 'available',\n        isPublished: true,\n        updatedAt: new Date()\n      };\n\n      // Note: This will need to be updated after the user is created\n      // For now, we'll redirect and let them update their profile\n      console.log('User registered successfully!');\n      navigate('/edit-profile');",

        "originalContents": "\n\n  // --- The new, combined handleSubmit logic ---\n  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) =\u003e {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    if (!form.email || !form.password || !form.name) {\n      setError(\"Please fill out your email, password, and name.\");\n      return;\n    }\n    setLoading(true);\n    setError(null);\n\n    try {\n      // 1. Create user in Firebase Auth using AuthContext (creates basic crewProfiles document)\n      await signup(form.email, form.password, form.name.split(' ')[0], form.name.split(' ').slice(1).join(' '));\n      \n      // 2. Upload profile image if one was selected\n      let uploadedImageUrl = '';\n      if (imageFile) {\n        const storageRef = ref(storage, &#96;profileImages/${form.email}&#96;);\n        await uploadBytes(storageRef, imageFile);\n        uploadedImageUrl = await getDownloadURL(storageRef);\n      }\n\n      // Always ensure name and image are set\n      const safeName = form.name \u0026\u0026 form.name.trim() !== '' ? form.name : 'Unknown Crew';\n      const safeProfileImageUrl = uploadedImageUrl \u0026\u0026 uploadedImageUrl.trim() !== '' ? uploadedImageUrl : '/default-avatar.svg';\n\n      // 3. Update the crewProfiles document with additional details\n      // Note: We need to get the user ID from the current user context\n      // For now, we'll create a more detailed profile after signup\n      const detailedProfile = {\n        name: safeName,\n        bio: form.bio,\n        profileImageUrl: safeProfileImageUrl,\n        jobTitles: form.jobTitles.filter(j =\u003e j.department \u0026\u0026 j.title), // Only save completed entries\n        residences: form.residences.filter(r =\u003e r.country \u0026\u0026 r.city),\n        userType: form.userType,\n        availability: 'available',\n        isPublished: true,\n        updatedAt: new Date()\n      };\n\n      // Note: This will need to be updated after the user is created\n      // For now, we'll redirect and let them update their profile\n      console.log('User registered successfully!');\n      navigate('/edit-profile');",

        "contents": "\n\n\nconst RegisterForm: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { signup } = useAuth();\n  const navigate = useNavigate(); // Optional: for redirecting\n\n  // --- State management now mirrors EditCrewProfile ---\n  const [form, setForm] = useState\u003cFormData\u003e({\n    email: '',\n    password: '',\n    name: '',\n    bio: '',\n    profileImageUrl: '',\n    jobTitles: [{ department: '', title: '' }],\n    residences: [{ country: 'Dominican Republic', city: '' }],\n    userType: 'Crew',\n  });\n\n  const [imageFile, setImageFile] = useState\u003cFile | null\u003e(null); // To hold the image file for upload\n  const [departments, setDepartments] = useState\u003cJobDepartment[]\u003e([]);\n  const [countryOptions, setCountryOptions] = useState\u003c{ name: string; cities: string[] }[]\u003e([]);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null);\n\n  // --- useEffect to load dropdown data (from EditCrewProfile) ---\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    const loadLookups = async () =\u003e {\n      try {\n        const deptData = await fetchJobDepartments();\n        setDepartments(deptData);\n\n        const countrySnap = await getDocs(collection(db, 'countries'));\n        setCountryOptions(\n          countrySnap.docs.map(doc =\u003e ({\n            name: doc.data().name as string,\n            cities: doc.data().cities as string[],\n          }))\n        );\n      } catch (err) {\n        console.error(\"Failed to load lookup data\", err);\n        setError(\"Could not load necessary data. Please try again later.\");\n      }\n    };\n    loadLookups();\n  }, []);\n\n  // --- All handlers are brought over from EditCrewProfile ---\n  const handleChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent\u003cHTMLInputElement | HTMLTextAreaElement | HTMLSelectElement\u003e) =\u003e {\n    const { name, value } = e.target;\n    setForm(f =\u003e ({ ...f, [name]: value }));\n  };\n\n  const handleImageFileChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent\u003cHTMLInputElement\u003e) =\u003e {\n    if (e.target.files?.[0]) {\n      setImageFile(e.target.files[0]);\n    }\n  };",

        "originalContents": "\n\n\nconst RegisterForm: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { signup } = useAuth();\n  const navigate = useNavigate(); // Optional: for redirecting\n\n  // --- State management now mirrors EditCrewProfile ---\n  const [form, setForm] = useState\u003cFormData\u003e({\n    email: '',\n    password: '',\n    name: '',\n    bio: '',\n    profileImageUrl: '',\n    jobTitles: [{ department: '', title: '' }],\n    residences: [{ country: 'Dominican Republic', city: '' }],\n    userType: 'Crew',\n  });\n\n  const [imageFile, setImageFile] = useState\u003cFile | null\u003e(null); // To hold the image file for upload\n  const [departments, setDepartments] = useState\u003cJobDepartment[]\u003e([]);\n  const [countryOptions, setCountryOptions] = useState\u003c{ name: string; cities: string[] }[]\u003e([]);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null);\n\n  // --- useEffect to load dropdown data (from EditCrewProfile) ---\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    const loadLookups = async () =\u003e {\n      try {\n        const deptData = await fetchJobDepartments();\n        setDepartments(deptData);\n\n        const countrySnap = await getDocs(collection(db, 'countries'));\n        setCountryOptions(\n          countrySnap.docs.map(doc =\u003e ({\n            name: doc.data().name as string,\n            cities: doc.data().cities as string[],\n          }))\n        );\n      } catch (err) {\n        console.error(\"Failed to load lookup data\", err);\n        setError(\"Could not load necessary data. Please try again later.\");\n      }\n    };\n    loadLookups();\n  }, []);\n\n  // --- All handlers are brought over from EditCrewProfile ---\n  const handleChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent\u003cHTMLInputElement | HTMLTextAreaElement | HTMLSelectElement\u003e) =\u003e {\n    const { name, value } = e.target;\n    setForm(f =\u003e ({ ...f, [name]: value }));\n  };\n\n  const handleImageFileChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent\u003cHTMLInputElement\u003e) =\u003e {\n    if (e.target.files?.[0]) {\n      setImageFile(e.target.files[0]);\n    }\n  };",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "// src/components/Login.tsx\n\n// test comment\n\nimport React, { useState } from 'react';\nimport { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { signInWithEmailAndPassword } from 'firebase/auth';\nimport { auth } from '../firebase';\nimport { Form, FormInput, FormFieldGroup } from './ui/Form';\nimport { Button } from './ui/Button';\nimport { Eye, EyeOff, Mail, Lock, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';\nimport { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';\nimport { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';\n\nconst Login: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const { loginWithGoogle, loginWithApple } = useAuth();\n  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');\n  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');\n  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState('');\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n\n  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) =\u003e {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    if (loading) return; // Prevent double submission\n    setLoading(true);\n    setError('');\n\n    const trimmedEmail = email.trim();\n    const trimmedPassword = password.trim();\n\n    if (!trimmedEmail || !trimmedPassword) {\n      setError(t('auth.errors.emailPasswordRequired'));\n      setLoading(false);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      await signInWithEmailAndPassword(auth, trimmedEmail, trimmedPassword);\n      navigate('/');\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error('Login error:', error);\n      setError(\n        error.code === 'auth/user-not-found' || error.code === 'auth/wrong-password'\n          ? t('auth.errors.invalidCredentials')\n          : error.code === 'auth/too-many-requests'\n          ? t('auth.errors.tooManyRequests')\n          : t('auth.errors.loginError')\n      );\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };",

        "originalContents": "// src/components/Login.tsx\n\n// test comment\n\nimport React, { useState } from 'react';\nimport { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { signInWithEmailAndPassword } from 'firebase/auth';\nimport { auth } from '../firebase';\nimport { Form, FormInput, FormFieldGroup } from './ui/Form';\nimport { Button } from './ui/Button';\nimport { Eye, EyeOff, Mail, Lock, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';\nimport { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';\nimport { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';\n\nconst Login: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const { loginWithGoogle, loginWithApple } = useAuth();\n  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');\n  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');\n  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState('');\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n\n  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) =\u003e {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    if (loading) return; // Prevent double submission\n    setLoading(true);\n    setError('');\n\n    const trimmedEmail = email.trim();\n    const trimmedPassword = password.trim();\n\n    if (!trimmedEmail || !trimmedPassword) {\n      setError(t('auth.errors.emailPasswordRequired'));\n      setLoading(false);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      await signInWithEmailAndPassword(auth, trimmedEmail, trimmedPassword);\n      navigate('/');\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error('Login error:', error);\n      setError(\n        error.code === 'auth/user-not-found' || error.code === 'auth/wrong-password'\n          ? t('auth.errors.invalidCredentials')\n          : error.code === 'auth/too-many-requests'\n          ? t('auth.errors.tooManyRequests')\n          : t('auth.errors.loginError')\n      );\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };",

Excellent! ✅ I've successfully fixed the issue. Here's what I found and resolved:

## Problem Identified ��
The issue was that the router was using different components than the ones that had the Google and Apple authentication buttons implemented:

- **Router was using:** `LoginPage.tsx` and `RegisterPage.tsx`
- **Components with auth buttons:** `Login.tsx` and `Register.tsx`

## Solution Implemented ✅

I added the Google and Apple authentication buttons to both the actual components being used:

### 1. **RegisterPage.tsx** - Added:
- ✅ Google sign-in button with proper styling and icon
- ✅ Apple sign-in button with proper styling and icon
- ✅ Proper error handling for both providers
- ✅ "or" divider between social login and email form

### 2. **LoginPage.tsx** - Added:
- ✅ Google sign-in button with proper styling and icon
- ✅ Apple sign-in button with proper styling and icon
- ✅ Proper error handling for both providers
- ✅ "or" divider between social login and email form

## Changes Made:
- **5 files changed**
- **183 insertions, 6 deletions**
- Added authentication functions from `useAuth()` hook
- Added proper error handling for popup blocks and provider issues
- Maintained consistent styling with the existing design

## Result 🎯
Now when users visit the login and registration pages, they will see:
1. **Google button** (white background with Google logo)
2. **Apple button** (black background with Apple logo)
3. **"or" divider**
4. **Traditional email/password form**

The authentication providers are now **visible and functional** on both the login and registration pages! 🚀

Perfect! ✅ I've fixed the Google authentication popup issue. Here's what I implemented:

## Problem Identified 🔍
The Google authentication popup was showing "my-film-jobs.firebaseapp.com" instead of "My Film Jobs" because Firebase was using the default project name.

## Solution Implemented ✅

I modified the `loginWithGoogle` function in `src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx` to set custom parameters:

```typescript
provider.setCustomParameters({
  app_name: 'My Film Jobs',
  prompt: 'select_account'
});
```

## Changes Made:
- ✅ **Added custom parameters** to the GoogleAuthProvider
- ✅ **Set `app_name`** to "My Film Jobs" 
- ✅ **Added `prompt: 'select_account'`** to always show the account selection dialog
- ✅ **Both LoginPage and RegisterPage** automatically benefit from this change since they use the AuthContext

## Result 🎯
Now when users click the Google sign-in button, the popup will show:
- **"My Film Jobs"** instead of "my-film-jobs.firebaseapp.com"
- **Account selection dialog** for better UX
- **Consistent branding** across the authentication flow

The fix is now committed to the `inventando` branch and ready for testing! 🚀

        "contents": "\nimport { getStorage } from \"firebase/storage\";\n\nconst firebaseConfig = {\n  apiKey:     process.env.REACT_APP_FIREBASE_API_KEY,\n  authDomain: process.env.REACT_APP_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN,\n  projectId:  process.env.REACT_APP_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID,\n  storageBucket: process.env.REACT_APP_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET,\n  messagingSenderId: process.env.REACT_APP_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID,\n  appId:      process.env.REACT_APP_FIREBASE_APP_ID,\n};\n\nconst app = initializeApp(firebaseConfig);\nconst auth = getAuth(app);\n\n// Initialize Firestore with settings to prevent internal assertion errors\nconst db = initializeFirestore(app, {\n  cacheSizeBytes: 50 * 1024 * 1024, // 50MB cache\n  experimentalForceLongPolling: true, // Use long polling instead of WebSocket\n});\n\nconst storage = getStorage(app);\n\n// Error handling for Firestore\nconst handleFirestoreError = (error: any) =\u003e {\n  console.error('Firestore error:', error);\n  // Attempt to reconnect if there's a connection issue\n  if (error.code === 'unavailable' || error.code === 'deadline-exceeded') {\n    console.log('Attempting to reconnect to Firestore...');\n    enableNetwork(db).catch(console.error);\n  }\n};",

        "contents": "firebase deploy --only storage --project your-prod-project-id\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Storage Folders:**\n- [ ] &#96;project-images/&#96; - Public read, auth write\n- [ ] &#96;profileImages/&#96; - Public read, auth write\n- [ ] &#96;screenplays/&#96; - Public read, auth write\n- [ ] &#96;chat-uploads/&#96; - Auth only\n- [ ] &#96;chat-images/&#96; - Auth only\n- [ ] &#96;chat-audio/&#96; - Auth only\n- [ ] &#96;users/{userId}/&#96; - User-specific access\n\n### 6. ⚡ Cloud Functions\nDeploy the functions from &#96;functions/src/index.ts&#96;:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nfirebase deploy --only functions --project your-prod-project-id\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Current Functions:**\n- [ ] &#96;notifyJobPosterOnApplication&#96; - Notifies job poster on new application\n\n### 7. 🌐 Hosting Configuration\nDeploy the hosting configuration:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nfirebase deploy --only hosting --project your-prod-project-id\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Hosting Settings:**\n- [ ] Public directory: &#96;public&#96;\n- [ ] SPA fallback: &#96;index.html&#96;\n- [ ] Ignore patterns configured\n\n### 8. 📝 Reference Data Seeding\n\n#### Job Titles (if needed):\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm run seed:job-titles\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Job Departments (if needed):\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm run seed:job-departments\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Countries (if needed):\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm run seed:countries\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 9. 🔧 Environment Configuration\n\n#### Create &#96;.env.production&#96;:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;env\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_API_KEY=your_prod_api_key\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN=your_prod_project.firebaseapp.com\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=your_prod_project_id\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET=your_prod_project.appspot.com\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID=your_prod_sender_id\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_APP_ID=your_prod_app_id\nREACT_APP_ENV=production\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Update &#96;package.json&#96;:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"scripts\": {\n    \"deploy:prod\": \"firebase deploy --project your-prod-project-id\"\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 10. 🚀 Complete Deployment Commands\n\n#### First-Time Setup:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 1. Initialize Firebase for production\nfirebase use --add\n# Select your production project\n\n# 2. Deploy everything\nfirebase deploy --project your-prod-project-id\n\n# 3. - Public read, auth write\n- [ ] &#96;screenplays/&#96; - Public read, auth write\n- [ ] &#96;chat-uploads/&#96; - Auth only\n- [ ] &#96;chat-images/&#96; - Auth only\n- [ ] &#96;chat-audio/&#96; - Auth only\n- [ ] &#96;users/{userId}/&#96; - User-specific access\n\n### 6. ⚡ Cloud Functions\nDeploy the functions from &#96;functions/src/index.ts&#96;:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nfirebase deploy --only functions --project your-prod-project-id\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Current Functions:**\n- [ ] &#96;notifyJobPosterOnApplication&#96; - Notifies job poster on new application\n\n### 7. 🌐 Hosting Configuration\nDeploy the hosting configuration:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nfirebase deploy --only hosting --project your-prod-project-id\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Hosting Settings:**\n- [ ] Public directory: &#96;public&#96;\n- [ ] SPA fallback: &#96;index.html&#96;\n- [ ] Ignore patterns configured\n\n### 8. 📝 Reference Data Seeding\n\n#### Job Titles (if needed):\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm run seed:job-titles\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Job Departments (if needed):\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm run seed:job-departments\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Countries (if needed):\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm run seed:countries\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 9. 🔧 Environment Configuration\n\n#### Create &#96;.env.production&#96;:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;env\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_API_KEY=your_prod_api_key\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN=your_prod_project.firebaseapp.com\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=your_prod_project_id\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET=your_prod_project.appspot.com\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID=your_prod_sender_id\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_APP_ID=your_prod_app_id\nREACT_APP_ENV=production\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Update &#96;package.json&#96;:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"scripts\": {\n    \"deploy:prod\": \"firebase deploy --project your-prod-project-id\"\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 10. 🚀 Complete Deployment Commands\n\n#### First-Time Setup:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 1. Initialize Firebase for production\nfirebase use --add\n# Select your production project\n\n# 2. Deploy everything\nfirebase deploy --project your-prod-project-id\n\n# 3. Or deploy components individually:\n",

        "contents": "# 🚀 Deployment Guide\n\n## Branch Strategy\n\n### Branches:\n- **&#96;main&#96;** - Production-ready code (deployed to live site)\n- **&#96;develop&#96;** - New features and development work\n- **&#96;feature/xyz&#96;** - Individual feature branches (optional)\n\n## Workflow\n\n### 1. Development Workflow\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Always work on develop branch for new features\ngit checkout develop\n\n# Create feature branch (optional)\ngit checkout -b feature/new-feature\n\n# Make your changes and commit\ngit add .\ngit commit -m \"Add new feature\"\n\n# Push to remote\ngit push origin develop\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. Deploy to Production\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Switch to main branch\ngit checkout main\n\n# Merge develop into main\ngit merge develop\n\n# Push to production\ngit push origin main\n\n# Deploy to Firebase\nnpm run deploy:prod\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. After Deployment\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Switch back to develop for next features\ngit checkout develop\n\n# Pull latest changes\ngit pull origin main\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Environment Configuration\n\n### Development Environment (.env.development)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;env\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_API_KEY=your_dev_api_key\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN=your_dev_project.firebaseapp.com\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=your_dev_project_id\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET=your_dev_project.appspot.com\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID=your_dev_sender_id\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_APP_ID=your_dev_app_id\nREACT_APP_ENV=development\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Production Environment (.env.production)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;env\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_API_KEY=your_prod_api_key\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN=your_prod_project.firebaseapp.com\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=your_prod_project_id\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET=your_prod_project.appspot.com\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID=your_prod_sender_id\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_APP_ID=your_prod_app_id\nREACT_APP_ENV=production\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Firebase Projects Setup\n\n### 1. Create Production Firebase Project\n1. Go to [Firebase Console](https://console.firebase.google.com/)\n2. Create new project with your production name\n3. Set up Authentication, Firestore, Storage\n",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "#!/bin/bash\n\n# 🔥 Firebase Production Setup Script\n# This script helps you set up your production Firebase environment\n\necho \"🔥 Firebase Production Setup\"\necho \"==============================\"\n\n# Check if Firebase CLI is installed\nif ! command -v firebase \u0026\u003e /dev/null; then\n    echo \"❌ Firebase CLI not found. Please install it first:\"\n    echo \"   npm install -g firebase-tools\"\n    exit 1\nfi\n\n# Check if user is logged in\nif ! firebase projects:list \u0026\u003e /dev/null; then\n    echo \"❌ Not logged into Firebase. Please login first:\"\n    echo \"   firebase login\"\n    exit 1\nfi\n\necho \"✅ Firebase CLI is ready\"\n\n# Get production project ID\necho \"\"\necho \"📋 Please provide your production Firebase project ID:\"\nread -p \"Production Project ID: \" PROD_PROJECT_ID\n\nif [ -z \"$PROD_PROJECT_ID\" ]; then\n    echo \"❌ Project ID cannot be empty\"\n    exit 1\nfi\n\necho \"\"\necho \"🔧 Setting up Firebase for production...\"\n\n# Add production project to Firebase\necho \"Adding production project to Firebase configuration...\"\nfirebase use --add $PROD_PROJECT_ID\n\nif [ $? -ne 0 ]; then\n    echo \"❌ Failed to add production project. Please check your project ID.\"\n    exit 1\nfi\n\n# Update package.json with production project ID\necho \"Updating package.json with production project ID...\"\nsed -i.bak \"s/your-prod-project-id/$PROD_PROJECT_ID/g\" package.json\n\n# Create .env.production template\necho \"Creating .env.production template...\"\ncat \u003e .env.production.template \u003c\u003c EOF\n# Production Environment Configuration\n# Copy this file to .env.production and fill in your actual values\n\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_API_KEY=your_prod_api_key_here\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN=$PROD_PROJECT_ID.firebaseapp.com\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=$PROD_PROJECT_ID\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET=$PROD_PROJECT_ID.appspot.com\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID=your_prod_messaging_sender_id_here\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_APP_ID=your_prod_app_id_here\nREACT_APP_ENV=production\nEOF\n\necho \"\"\n",

        "originalContents": "#!/bin/bash\n\n# 🔥 Firebase Production Setup Script\n# This script helps you set up your production Firebase environment\n\necho \"🔥 Firebase Production Setup\"\necho \"==============================\"\n\n# Check if Firebase CLI is installed\nif ! command -v firebase \u0026\u003e /dev/null; then\n    echo \"❌ Firebase CLI not found. Please install it first:\"\n    echo \"   npm install -g firebase-tools\"\n    exit 1\nfi\n\n# Check if user is logged in\nif ! firebase projects:list \u0026\u003e /dev/null; then\n    echo \"❌ Not logged into Firebase. Please login first:\"\n    echo \"   firebase login\"\n    exit 1\nfi\n\necho \"✅ Firebase CLI is ready\"\n\n# Get production project ID\necho \"\"\necho \"📋 Please provide your production Firebase project ID:\"\nread -p \"Production Project ID: \" PROD_PROJECT_ID\n\nif [ -z \"$PROD_PROJECT_ID\" ]; then\n    echo \"❌ Project ID cannot be empty\"\n    exit 1\nfi\n\necho \"\"\necho \"🔧 Setting up Firebase for production...\"\n\n# Add production project to Firebase\necho \"Adding production project to Firebase configuration...\"\nfirebase use --add $PROD_PROJECT_ID\n\nif [ $? -ne 0 ]; then\n    echo \"❌ Failed to add production project. Please check your project ID.\"\n    exit 1\nfi\n\n# Update package.json with production project ID\necho \"Updating package.json with production project ID...\"\nsed -i.bak \"s/your-prod-project-id/$PROD_PROJECT_ID/g\" package.json\n\n# Create .env.production template\necho \"Creating .env.production template...\"\ncat \u003e .env.production.template \u003c\u003c EOF\n# Production Environment Configuration\n# Copy this file to .env.production and fill in your actual values\n\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_API_KEY=your_prod_api_key_here\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN=$PROD_PROJECT_ID.firebaseapp.com\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=$PROD_PROJECT_ID\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET=$PROD_PROJECT_ID.appspot.com\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID=your_prod_messaging_sender_id_here\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_APP_ID=your_prod_app_id_here\nREACT_APP_ENV=production\nEOF\n\necho \"\"\n",

Actually, let me be honest - the custom parameters approach won't work to change the domain name that Google shows. The domain name "my-film-jobs.firebaseapp.com" is controlled by the Firebase project configuration itself.

The proper solution is to configure a custom domain in the Firebase Console. Here's what needs to be done:

## The Real Solution 🔧

To change "my-film-jobs.firebaseapp.com" to "My Film Jobs" in the Google authentication popup, you need to:

### 1. **Configure Custom Domain in Firebase Console:**
- Go to Firebase Console → Authentication → Settings → Authorized domains
- Add your custom domain (e.g., `myfilmjobs.com`)
- Configure the OAuth consent screen in Google Cloud Console

### 2. **Update Firebase Configuration:**
The `authDomain` in your Firebase config should point to your custom domain instead of the Firebase project domain.

## Summary 📋

The issue you're seeing is **expected behavior**. The Google authentication popup will always show the Firebase project's auth domain ("my-film-jobs.firebaseapp.com") because that's how Firebase Authentication works.

### To Fix This Properly:

1. **Firebase Console Configuration:**
   - Go to Firebase Console → Authentication → Settings → Authorized domains
   - Add your custom domain (e.g., `myfilmjobs.com`)
   - Configure the OAuth consent screen in Google Cloud Console

2. **Update Environment Variables:**
   - Change `REACT_APP_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN` to your custom domain
   - This requires Firebase project configuration changes

### Current Status:
- ✅ Google and Apple authentication buttons are now visible
- ✅ Authentication functionality works correctly
- ⚠️ The domain name in the popup is a Firebase configuration issue, not a code issue

The authentication is working properly - the domain name display is a Firebase project configuration that needs to be changed in the Firebase Console, not in the code.

Perfect! I've opened both consoles for you. Here's what you need to do to fix the Google authentication popup domain name:

## 🔧 Steps to Fix the Domain Name Issue:

### 1. **Firebase Console (Authentication Settings):**
- Go to **Authentication** → **Settings** → **Authorized domains**
- Add your custom domain: `myfilmjobs.com`
- This will allow authentication from your custom domain

### 2. **Google Cloud Console (OAuth Consent Screen):**
- Go to **APIs & Services** → **OAuth consent screen**
- Update the **App name** to "My Film Jobs"
- Update the **User support email**
- Add your domain `myfilmjobs.com` to authorized domains
- Configure the app logo and other branding

### 3. **Update Environment Variables:**
Once you've configured the custom domain in Firebase, you'll need to update your environment variables:

```bash
REACT_APP_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN=myfilmjobs.com
```

### 4. **Alternative Quick Fix:**
If you want to keep using the Firebase domain but just change the display name, you can configure the OAuth consent screen in Google Cloud Console to show "My Film Jobs" as the app name instead of the domain.

## 🎯 Expected Result:
After these changes, the Google authentication popup should show:
- **"My Film Jobs"** instead of "my-film-jobs.firebaseapp.com"
- Your custom domain in the authorization flow

The Firebase CLI opened both consoles for you to make these configuration changes. Once you've updated the settings, the authentication popup should display your proper app name! 🚀

🎉 **Critical Fix Deployed Successfully!**

## ✅ **Issue Resolved:**

The resume saving error has been fixed! The problem was that the `level` field in education entries was being set to `undefined`, which Firestore doesn't allow.

## 🔧 **What Was Fixed:**

1. **Removed `undefined` values** from education entries in `addEducation()` function
2. **Added `removeUndefinedValues()` helper function** to clean data before saving to Firestore
3. **Fixed `getDefaultEducationEntry()` functions** to not include `level: undefined`
4. **Updated `DEFAULT_EDUCATION_ENTRY`** in types to not include `undefined` values

## 🚀 **Deployment Status:**

- **✅ Build:** Successful compilation
- **✅ Deploy:** Successfully deployed to `myfilmjobs.com`
- **✅ Functions:** Email service functions deployed
- **✅ Database:** Firestore rules and indexes updated

## 🧪 **Test the Fix:**

You can now test the resume saving functionality at:
- **Production:** `https://myfilmjobs.com`
- **Development:** `http://localhost:8080`

The resume should now save successfully without the "Unsupported field value: undefined" error! 🎯

## 📝 **Summary of Changes:**

1. **Fixed `addEducation()`** - Removed `level: undefined`
2. **Added data cleaning** - `removeUndefinedValues()` function filters out `undefined` values
3. **Updated default education entries** - Removed `undefined` values from all default education objects
4. **Enhanced save process** - Data is cleaned before saving to Firestore

The resume saving functionality should now work properly! 🚀

+   },
+   {
+     name: 'special',
+     test: (password: string) =&gt; /[!@#$%^&amp;*()_+\-=\[\]{};':"\\|,.&lt;&gt;\/?]/.test(password),
+     message: 'At least one special character (!@#$%^&amp;*...)'
+   }
+ ];
+ 
+ export const validatePassword = (password: string): PasswordValidationResult =&gt; {
+   const errors: string[] = [];
+   let score = 0;
+   
+   // Check each requirement
+   PASSWORD_REQUIREMENTS.forEach(requirement =&gt; {
+     if (requirement.test(password)) {
+       score += 20; // Each requirement adds 20 points
+     } else {
+       errors.push(requirement.message);
+     }
+   });
+   
+   // Additional scoring based on length and complexity
+   if (password.length &gt;= 12) score += 10;
+   if (password.length &gt;= 16) score += 10;
+   if (/[!@#$%^&amp;*()_+\-=\[\]{};':"\\|,.&lt;&gt;\/?].*[!@#$%^&amp;*()_+\-=\[\]{};':"\\|,.&lt;&gt;\/?]/.test(password)) {
+     score += 10; // Multiple special characters
+   }
+   if (/\d.*\d/.test(password)) {
+     score += 10; // Multiple numbers
+   }
+   
+   // Determine strength
+   let strength: 'weak' | 'medium' | 'strong' | 'very-strong';
+   if (score &lt; 60) strength = 'weak';
+   else if (score &lt; 80) strength = 'medium';
+   else if (score &lt; 100) strength = 'strong';
+   else strength = 'very-strong';
+   
+   return {
+     isValid: errors.length === 0,
+     errors,
+     strength,
+     score: Math.min(score, 100)
+   };
+ };
+ 
+ export const getPasswordStrengthColor = (strength: string): string =&gt; {
+   switch (strength) {
+     case 'weak': return 'text-red-500';
+     case 'medium': return 'text-yellow-500';
+     case 'strong': return 'text-blue-500';
+     case 'very-strong': return 'text-green-500';
+     default: return 'text-gray-500';
+   }
+ };
+ 
+ export const getPasswordStrengthText = (strength: string): string =&gt; {
+   switch (strength) {
+     case 'weak': return 'Weak';
+     case 'medium': return 'Medium';
+     case 'strong': return 'Strong';
+     case 'very-strong': return 'Very Strong';
+     default: return 'Unknown';
+   }
+ }; 
```

+       } else if (err.code === 'auth/wrong-password') {
+         setError('Incorrect password. Please try again.');
+       } else if (err.code === 'auth/too-many-requests') {
+         setError('Too many failed attempts. Please try again later.');
+       } else {
+         setError('Failed to log in. Please try again.');
+       }
        console.error(err);
      }
```

Perfect! ✅ **Google sign-in flow has been successfully updated!**

## 🎯 **New Google Sign-In Behavior:**

### ✅ **Smart Navigation Logic:**

#### **For New Users (First-time Google sign-in):**
- **📍 Register Page** → Google sign-in → **👤 Profile Builder** (`/edit-profile`)
- **🎯 Purpose:** Complete profile setup for new accounts
- **✅ Detection:** Checks if crew profile exists in Firestore

#### **For Existing Users (Returning Google sign-in):**
- **📍 Login Page** → Google sign-in → **�� Home Page** (`/`)
- **🎯 Purpose:** Quick access for returning users
- **✅ Detection:** Existing crew profile found in Firestore

### 🔧 **Technical Implementation:**

#### **AuthContext Updates:**
- **✅ `loginWithGoogle()`** now returns `{ isNewUser: boolean }`
- **✅ `createUserProfileIfNeeded()`** returns boolean indicating new/existing user
- **✅ Profile creation** only happens for new users
- **✅ Existing users** skip profile creation

#### **Page Logic Updates:**
- **✅ RegisterPage:** New users → `/edit-profile`, Existing users → `/`
- **✅ LoginPage:** Always → `/` (login page is for existing users)
- **✅ Error handling:** Maintains all existing error scenarios

### 🎯 **User Experience Flow:**

#### **New User Journey:**
1. **📝 User clicks "Continue with Google"** on Register page
2. **🔐 Google authentication** popup
3. **✅ Account created** in Firebase Auth
4. **👤 Profile created** in Firestore (crew profile + collections)
5. **🎯 Redirected** to Profile Builder to complete setup
6. **📋 User fills out** resume/profile information

#### **Existing User Journey:**
1. **🔑 User clicks "Continue with Google"** on Login page
2. **🔐 Google authentication** popup  
3. **✅ Account verified** in Firebase Auth
4. **�� Existing profile** found in Firestore
5. **🏠 Redirected** to Home page
6. **�� Ready** to use the platform

### ✅ **Build Status:**
- **✅ Compilation:** Successful with no errors
- **✅ TypeScript:** All type checking passed
- **✅ Functionality:** Ready for testing

The Google sign-in flow now intelligently routes users based on whether they're new or existing, providing the optimal experience for each scenario! 🚀

        "contents": "\n\nconst PublicResumePage: React.FC\u003cPublicResumePageProps\u003e = () =\u003e {\n  const { uid } = useParams\u003c{ uid: string }\u003e();\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const [profile, setProfile] = useState\u003cCrewProfile | null\u003e(null);\n  const [status, setStatus] = useState\u003cLoadingState\u003e(LOADING_STATES.LOADING);\n  const [error, setError] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    const fetchResume = async () =\u003e {\n      if (!uid) {\n        setStatus(LOADING_STATES.ERROR);\n        setError('No user ID provided');\n        return;\n      }\n\n      try {\n        setStatus(LOADING_STATES.LOADING);\n        const docRef = doc(db, 'crewProfiles', uid);\n        const docSnap = await getDoc(docRef);\n\n        if (!docSnap.exists()) {\n          throw new Error('Profile not found');\n        }\n\n        let profileData = docSnap.data() as CrewProfile;\n        // Fallback: use photoURL if profileImageUrl is missing\n        if (!profileData.profileImageUrl \u0026\u0026 profileData.photoURL) {\n          profileData = { ...profileData, profileImageUrl: profileData.photoURL };\n        }\n        console.log('[PublicResumePage] Fetched profile data:', {\n          hasProfileImage: !!profileData.profileImageUrl,\n          profileImageUrl: profileData.profileImageUrl,\n          isBlobUrl: profileData.profileImageUrl?.startsWith('blob:'),\n          profileData: { ...profileData, profileImageUrl: '...' }\n        });\n\n        if (!profileData.isPublished) {\n          throw new Error('Profile is not published');\n        }\n\n        setProfile(profileData);\n        setStatus(LOADING_STATES.SUCCESS);\n      } catch (err) {\n        console.error('Error fetching resume:', err);\n        setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'An unknown error occurred');\n        setStatus(LOADING_STATES.ERROR);\n      }\n    };\n\n    fetchResume();\n  }, [uid]);",

        "originalContents": "\n\nconst PublicResumePage: React.FC\u003cPublicResumePageProps\u003e = () =\u003e {\n  const { uid } = useParams\u003c{ uid: string }\u003e();\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const [profile, setProfile] = useState\u003cCrewProfile | null\u003e(null);\n  const [status, setStatus] = useState\u003cLoadingState\u003e(LOADING_STATES.LOADING);\n  const [error, setError] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    const fetchResume = async () =\u003e {\n      if (!uid) {\n        setStatus(LOADING_STATES.ERROR);\n        setError('No user ID provided');\n        return;\n      }\n\n      try {\n        setStatus(LOADING_STATES.LOADING);\n        const docRef = doc(db, 'crewProfiles', uid);\n        const docSnap = await getDoc(docRef);\n\n        if (!docSnap.exists()) {\n          throw new Error('Profile not found');\n        }\n\n        let profileData = docSnap.data() as CrewProfile;\n        // Fallback: use photoURL if profileImageUrl is missing\n        if (!profileData.profileImageUrl \u0026\u0026 profileData.photoURL) {\n          profileData = { ...profileData, profileImageUrl: profileData.photoURL };\n        }\n        console.log('[PublicResumePage] Fetched profile data:', {\n          hasProfileImage: !!profileData.profileImageUrl,\n          profileImageUrl: profileData.profileImageUrl,\n          isBlobUrl: profileData.profileImageUrl?.startsWith('blob:'),\n          profileData: { ...profileData, profileImageUrl: '...' }\n        });\n\n        if (!profileData.isPublished) {\n          throw new Error('Profile is not published');\n        }\n\n        setProfile(profileData);\n        setStatus(LOADING_STATES.SUCCESS);\n      } catch (err) {\n        console.error('Error fetching resume:', err);\n        setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'An unknown error occurred');\n        setStatus(LOADING_STATES.ERROR);\n      }\n    };\n\n    fetchResume();\n  }, [uid]);",

## 🔍 **Root Cause Analysis:**

The error `auth/invalid-credential` means:
- **❌ Wrong email/password combination**
- **❌ Account doesn't exist** 
- **❌ Account was deleted**

This is **NOT** related to the password validation we added for new registrations. The password validation only applies to **new user signups**, not to existing users trying to log in.

## ✅ **Solutions for Legacy Users:**

### **1. 🔑 Use "Forgot Password" Feature:**
- Click **"Forgot your password?"** link on the login page
- Enter your email address
- Check your email for password reset link
- Set a new password that meets the current requirements

### **2. �� Try Google Sign-In:**
- If you previously signed up with Google, use the **"Continue with Google"** button
- This bypasses password requirements entirely

### **3. 📧 Check Account Status:**
- Verify the email address is correct
- Make sure the account wasn't deleted or disabled

I've added specific error handling for `auth/invalid-credential` that provides a clearer message:
- **"Invalid email or password. Please check your credentials and try again."**

**The password validation only affects NEW registrations.** Existing users can still log in with their old passwords, but if they can't remember their password, they should:

3. **Contact support** if the account seems to be missing

The enhanced debugging will help identify the exact issue, and the "Forgot Password" feature provides a way for legacy users to regain access with a new password that meets current requirements.
